item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at transport infrastructure and defence industry facilities, as well as vessels used in the interest
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes at transport infrastructure and defence industry facilities, as well as vessels used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit: 📍 the Termoplast industry enterprise involved in the production of attack UAVs in Letichev (Khmelnitsky region); 📍 the Mpka-Ukraine plant producing and supplying electrotechnical equipment for the AFU in Zaporozhye; 📍 a 330 kV power substation in Krivoy Rog (Dnepropetrovsk region) and a 330 kV electric substation in Zhitomir, that support the operation of Ukrainian defence industry facilities; 📍 a logistics centre storing components to produce solid missile fuel in the settlement of Belaya Tserkov (Kiev region); 📍 a transport infrastructure facility in Zaporozhye; 📍 four railway locomotives used to transport weapons and military hardware in Krivoy Rog, Pershotravensk, and Bogdanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region); 📍 a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Ukraine in the Black Sea waters south-west of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔹 Development of logistics support for CSTO troops discussed in Saint Petersburg An international scientific and practical conference was held devoted to the development of logisti
item.description: Development of logistics support for CSTO troops discussed in Saint Petersburg An international scientific and practical conference was held devoted to the development of logistic and technical support of the Troops (Collective Forces) of the Collective Security Treaty Organisation in the Military Academy of Logistical Support named after General of the Army A.V. Khrulyov of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation. Key issues are: 🔹 development of the Collective Forces' logistic support system until 2040; 🔹 application of experience of modern armed conflicts; 🔹 active implementation of unmanned aerial vehicles and robotic systems to deliver cargoes to the front line. 💬 The main goal is to implement combat experience into the practice of joint exercising and employment of the Collective Forces. Russian Deputy Defence Minister Colonel General Valery Solodchuk noted: ‘The joint logistics support system must be timely, modern, and advanced.’ ❗️ The activities of the CSTO Defence Ministers Council Working Group are aimed at further developing of the logistics support system and will contribute to enhancing the defence capability of the armed forces of the CSTO member countries. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔹 Moscow and Beijing get aligned Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasiliy Osmakov took part in the first round of strategic consultations
item.description: Moscow and Beijing get aligned Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasiliy Osmakov took part in the first round of strategic consultations between the defence departments of Russia and China. Under the coordinating participation of the Main Directorate for International Military Cooperation of the Russian Defence Ministry, issues of mutual interest concerning the development of the situation in different regions of the world were discussed. As a result of the consultations, the parties stressed the importance and relevance of this dialogue mechanism and agreed to regularise it. According to the event's participants, the talks were productive and took place in a warm and friendly atmosphere. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 ‘We were sent to the slaughter’: Ukrainian POWs reveal AFU hidden side The servicemen of the 78th Air Assault Brigade and the 28th Mechanised Brigade of the AFU, captured in Slav
item.description: ‘We were sent to the slaughter’: Ukrainian POWs reveal AFU hidden side 💬 The servicemen of the 78th Air Assault Brigade and the 28th Mechanised Brigade of the AFU, captured in Slavyansk-Kramatorsk direction, spoke about the difficult situation on the front line and how their command treated them. ▫️ According to Vladimir Yankov, the AFU's rifleman, the victims' bodies are not evacuated from the roads . The prisoner believes that the command intentionally leaves the corpses there in order to avoid paying compensation to the families and to keep money for themselves. ▫️ His comrade, Aleksandr Tishchenko, complained about a severe food supply shortage : the fighters have been living without food or water for weeks and were forced to search for food in abandoned basements. ▫️ Another prisoner, Dmitry Gorobtsets, the 28th Mechanised Brigade's serviceman, said that company commander sent a group to the position, ensuring that it was safe there, but the servicemen immediately got under heavy fire. Before the deployment, the officer confiscated the subordinates' passports and bank cards and stated sincerely that they would no longer need money, as there was no chance to survive. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30794

‘We were sent to the slaughter’: Ukrainian POWs reveal AFU hidden side
💬
The servicemen of the 78th Air Assault Brigade and the 28th Mechanised Brigade of the AFU, captured in Slavyansk-Kramatorsk direction,
spoke about the difficult situation on the front line and how their command treated them.
▫️
According to Vladimir Yankov, the AFU's rifleman,
the victims' bodies are not evacuated from the roads
. The prisoner believes that the command intentionally leaves the corpses there in order to avoid paying compensation to the families and to keep money for themselves.
▫️
His comrade, Aleksandr Tishchenko,
complained about a severe food supply shortage
: the fighters have been living without food or water for weeks and were forced to search for food in abandoned basements.
▫️
Another prisoner, Dmitry Gorobtsets, the 28th Mechanised Brigade's serviceman, said that company commander sent a group to the position, ensuring that it was safe there, but the servicemen immediately got under heavy fire. Before the deployment,
the officer confiscated the subordinates' passports and bank cards and stated sincerely that they would no longer need money,
as there was no chance to survive.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30792

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 26 November 2026
The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, strikes have been delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one national guard brigade close to Sosnovka, Velikiy Burluk, Kolodeznoye, and Pitomnik.
💥
In Sumy region,
formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade
have been hit
close to Obody, Vakalovshchina, Zhovtnevoye, and Novopetrovka.
▪️
The enemy lost up to 155 troops, six motor vehicles, three electronic warfare stations, and one electronic reconnaissance station.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Osadkovka, Vasilevka, Maliyevka (Kharkov region) and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 15 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU have been hit near Cherevkovka, Vysokoivanovka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, and Belenkoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 11 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out active offensive operations.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades near Kalinino, Kuritsyno, Krinitsy, Novopavlovka, and Zavido-Kudashevo (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 340 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, seven armoured fighting vehicles, six motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one air assault brigade, one assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Veseloye, Novotroitskoye, Novoivanovka, Novorozovka (Zaporozhye region) and Gavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 200 troops and eight motor vehicles.
↗️
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted fire damage on formations of one mechanised brigade of the AFU near Kamyshevakha (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 20 troops and 16 motor vehicles of the AFU have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have hit
power infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, production workshops and storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and ground robotic systems, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four U.S.-made JDAM aerial bombs, two Neptune long-range guided missiles, and 872 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
298,885
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,782
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,797
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,989
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
78,075
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
